in_marathi.name: Ketaki
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ketaki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ketaki is the goddess of flowers. She is often depicted carrying a garland of flowers and is considered to be the embodiment of love, beauty, and purity.

in_bengali.name: Ketaki
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of flowers
